messages:
Olivia: quick UX check — keyboard-only reorder for the policy stacks. Two concerns: (1) how the drag handle looks on focus, (2) what we read out via screen reader when an item moves. Screenshot + suggested copy below. PTAL :eyes: Leo: love the intent. For SR copy, prefer explicit position + name: 'Policy "Block large responses" moved to position 2 of 6.' avoids vague verbs. Also use `aria-live='polite'` so it doesn't interrupt typing. Marie: +1 on explicit position. Example snippet: ```html
Policy "Block large responses" moved to position 2 of 6
``` That should be reliable and not too noisy. Sam: we should support cancel via ESC too. If a user cancels a drag, announce: 'Reorder canceled' and show an inline toast with Undo. UX: toast text = 'Reorder canceled — changes not saved. Undo' (link). Olivia: good call. Also copy for validation states: currently error tooltip just says 'invalid' which is confusing. Suggest: 'Conflicting priority: this policy overlaps with "Allow internal traffic". Adjust conditions or move priority.' Leo: small UI note — when the preview/sim replay runs, the spinner looks like a system error in low-contrast themes. Could we add a subtle 'Simulation' badge in the preview header and use a skeleton state rather than the same spinner? Marie: accessibility nit — priority chips fail contrast on the green variants. Also add `aria-describedby` on the group label to point to helper text that explains priority semantics (higher = earlier). Sam: touch concern: 32px handle is ok for mouse but tiny for thumbs. Consider a tap-to-select reorder mode on mobile (long-press to enter reorder) and larger touch targets for handles. ui-bot: Figma mock updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/reorder-prototype — components: drag-handle v2, aria-live examples, toast pattern. Olivia: thanks everyone — I'll update the figma and add aria-live examples + undo toast copy. Sync tomorrow 10:00 for final sign-off.
